Multi omics integration with block-weighted PCs

Source: R/block_pca.R
runBlockPCA.Rd

Joint embedding of two or more feature types from their own dimension reductions (multiblock PCA with block scaling; Westerhuis et al. 1998, J Chemometrics 12:301). Each feature type's coordinates (a block) are divided by the square root of their total variance, so no block dominates by its number of dimensions or its scale, multiplied by the square root of its weight and concatenated. With rotate = TRUE the concatenation is rotated to its principal axes, so its dimensions are ordered by variance as in a PCA; a rotation keeps all distances, so neighbors computed on all dimensions are the same either way.

Memory and time are linear in the number of cells (one N x d matrix, d the dimensions summed over the feature types), so this scales to whole slides and works on GiottoDisk-backed objects.

Usage

runBlockPCA(
  gobject,
  spat_unit = "cell",
  feat_types = c("rna", "protein"),
  reduction_methods = c("pca", "pca"),
  reduction_names = NULL,
  dimensions_to_use = NULL,
  block_weights = NULL,
  rotate = TRUE,
  name = "blockpca",
  integrated_k = 20,
  integrated_network_name = paste0(name, "_kNN"),
  integrated_snn = c("none", "giotto", "jaccard"),
  snn_prune = 1/15,
  integrated_snn_name = NULL,
  engine = c("dbscan", "hnsw"),
  n_threads = NULL,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

gobject

A Giotto object with a dimension reduction (e.g. PCA) for each feature type in feat_types.

spat_unit

spatial unit

feat_types

feature types to integrate (two or more). The joint embedding is stored under each of them.

reduction_methods

reduction method of each feature type's embedding. Default c("pca", "pca").

reduction_names

name of each feature type's embedding. NULL (default) uses the names runPCA() gives: "pca" for rna, "<feat_type>.pca" otherwise. list_dim_reductions(gobject) lists the stored names.

dimensions_to_use

dimensions (indices) of each embedding to use: one integer vector for all feature types, or a list with one per feature type (named by feature type, or in the order of feat_types). Indices beyond those stored are dropped. NULL (default): all stored dimensions.

block_weights

share of the joint variance given to each feature type. NULL (default) weights them equally; otherwise one positive number per feature type (named by feature type, or in the order of feat_types), rescaled to sum to 1.

rotate

logical. Rotate the joint embedding to its principal axes (default TRUE).

name

name of the stored embedding. Default "blockpca".

integrated_k

number of neighbors of each cell in the integrated kNN, searched on all dimensions of the joint embedding. Default 20.

integrated_network_name

name of the integrated kNN network, stored as a kNN network under feat_types[1]. Default "<name>_kNN".

integrated_snn

shared nearest neighbor network of the integrated kNN to store for clustering, as an sNN network named integrated_snn_name under feat_types[1], as in runWNN(). "none" (default) stores no sNN; "giotto" keeps the kNN edges whose cells share at least 5 neighbors, plus each cell's 3 strongest (as createNearestNetwork(type = "sNN")); "jaccard" weights every kNN edge by the Jaccard overlap of the two cells' neighbor sets and drops edges below snn_prune.

snn_prune

smallest Jaccard overlap kept with integrated_snn = "jaccard". Default 1/15.

integrated_snn_name

name of the sNN network. NULL (default): integrated_network_name with "kNN" replaced by "sNN".

engine

neighbor search: "dbscan" (exact, default) or "hnsw" (approximate, faster on large data).

n_threads

threads of the "hnsw" search. NULL: its default.

verbose

be verbose

Value

The Giotto object with the joint embedding stored, for every feature type in feat_types, as reduction method "blockpca" named name; the integrated kNN (integrated_network_name) and, unless integrated_snn = "none", its sNN (integrated_snn_name) under feat_types[1]. Cluster with doLeidenCluster(feat_type = feat_types[1], nn_network_to_use = "sNN", network_name = integrated_snn_name) and embed with runIntegratedUMAP(graph = "knn", network_name = integrated_network_name), as for runWNN().

Details

For block b with selected coordinates X_b (cells x d_b) and weight w_b, the joint embedding is [X_1 s_1, ..., X_B s_B] with s_b = sqrt(w_b / sum_j var(X_b[, j])), so block b holds w_b of the total variance (1). The rotation centers the joint embedding and projects it on the eigenvectors of its covariance, each signed so that its largest entry is positive.

Stored in the misc slot of each dimension reduction: eigenvalues (the variance of each joint dimension; NULL without rotation) and block_input, with the feature types, embeddings and dimensions used, the weights, the scale factors s_b, and block_share, the share of each joint dimension's variance that comes from each block.

Unlike runWNN(), the weights are the same for every cell.

See also

runWNN(), runIntegratedUMAP()

Examples

g <- GiottoData::loadGiottoMini("visium")
x <- getExpression(g, values = "raw", output = "matrix")[1:30, ]
g <- setExpression(g, createExprObj(x, name = "raw", feat_type = "protein"))
g <- normalizeGiotto(g, feat_type = "protein", verbose = FALSE)
g <- runPCA(g, feat_type = "protein", feats_to_use = NULL, ncp = 10)

g <- runBlockPCA(g, feat_types = c("rna", "protein"),
    dimensions_to_use = list(1:10, 1:10), integrated_k = 10,
    integrated_snn = "giotto")
getDimReduction(g, reduction_method = "blockpca", name = "blockpca",
    output = "matrix")[1:3, 1:3]
g <- doLeidenCluster(g, nn_network_to_use = "sNN",
    network_name = "blockpca_sNN", name = "cluster_block")
g <- runIntegratedUMAP(g, graph = "knn", network_name = "blockpca_kNN",
    k = 10, name = "umap_block")
